tutorial_text:
1. Shoot in a well-lit place.

2. Keep the photo sharp.

3. Frame the snake's BODY, not just the head. Identification relies on the body pattern.

4. Use the gallery if you prefer.

Keep a safe distance!

no_snake_found_message:
Automatic detection didn't locate the snake in this photo. This usually happens when the animal is far away, camouflaged or poorly lit — and it doesn't necessarily mean there is no snake in the image.

You can identify it anyway. Species recognition is a separate step and often succeeds even when detection fails.
